newsitem.title: USA: AEP may not hit gross margin goal until '98.
newsitem.headline: AEP may not hit gross margin goal until '98.

text.p: AEP Industries Inc said Monday that it will try to return its gross margin to a level of between 23 percent and 24 percent in the second half of the year, but that it may not achieve that goal until early fiscal 1998.

Gross profit as a percentage of net sales in the second quarter was 20.5 percent, said the company, reflecting lower average selling prices and lower capacity utilization in North American pallet wrap.
Earlier, AEP reported earnings of $1.99 million and operating income of $8.6 million on sales of $190.3 million in the second quarter ended April 30.
Brendan Barba, CEO of the company, said the second quarter was also "difficult" because of unexpected price pressure in its U.S industrial film business.

Barba said that the company would focus on strengthening its marketing efforts and might adjust pricing to maintain its market share in its North American businesses. He added that AEP was ahead of its projected cost savings as of the second quarter.
AEP makes and sells plastic packaging products for the food, beverage, industrial and agricultural markets.
